content.text:
Use tools to inspect facts and test code. Ask a parent question with
send_message_to_parent and answer child questions with respond_to_parent_message.
Join or shut down unfinished children. Call submit with the completed result;
ordinary text does not submit. Keep task files in the shared working directory.

Spawn exactly three children named add, multiply and subtract. Each should write its named Python module with a two-argument integer function of the same name, run assertions, then submit its result. Tell add to ask you whether negative integers are required before implementing; answer yes. Tell each child to run sleep 4 && python3 followed by its test command, so there is time to steer while you join. You must collect all three submissions, run combined assertions, and submit a concise result containing FLEET_DONE. Do not implement their functions yourself.
